info.name: fintrack-api
info.description:
This collection covers the core REST API endpoints for **FinTrack**, a personal finance tracking application. It is organized into five functional modules:

- **Auth** — Handles user registration and login, including token issuance and credential validation.
    
- **Users** — Manages user accounts: listing all users, retrieving a user by ID, fetching the currently authenticated user, creating, and deleting users.
    
- **Accounts** — Provides full CRUD operations for financial accounts linked to a user, including balance management.
    
- **Transactions** — Manages financial transactions (income/expenses) with support for creating, reading, updating, and deleting entries. Balance recalculation is handled automatically on update and delete.
    
- **Categories** — Allows categorization of transactions. Admin-restricted endpoints control the creation, update, and deletion of categories.
    

Each request includes documented response examples covering success cases (2xx) as well as common error scenarios (400, 401, 403, 404, 409, 429), making this collection suitable for both development and testing workflows.
